info.name: Crime OS — Complaint Intelligence API
info.description:
Production-ready REST API for the Complaint Intelligence service.

Base URL: http://localhost:8001

Endpoints:
- Health & diagnostics
- Job management
- Complaint profile (LLM)
- Text intelligence (NER + events)
- Image worker (Pillow + Florence-2)

request.description: Returns service health status, version, and dependency connectivity.
Kubernetes liveness probe — always 200 if the process is alive.
Kubernetes readiness probe — checks Redis connectivity.
Poll job status and retrieve result when complete.

Submit complaint text for LLM-based profile generation.

Returns:
- 200: ComplaintProfile with summary, crime type, severity, etc.
- 422: Missing required fields
- 502: LLM service unreachable

response.name: 200 OK — ComplaintProfile
response.body:
{
  "complaint_id": "FIR-2026-AHM-001",

  "severity": "high",

}

request.description:
Extract entities (NER + regex) and events from text.

Returns TextIntelligenceResult with:
- entities (phone, email, amount, date, UPI, Aadhaar, PAN, etc.)
- events (temporal events with actors, actions, locations)
- processing metadata

response.name: 200 OK — TextIntelligenceResult

request.description: Pass OCR-extracted text for entity and event extraction.

formdata.description: Replace with actual image file path

request.description:
Upload a crime scene image.

If no text is detected:
→ Florence-2 caption → EvidenceProfile returned immediately
HTTP 200 OK

If text is detected:
→ OCR job queued → EvidenceProfile with status=pending_ocr
HTTP 202 Accepted

curl example:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/analyze-image -F "file=@crime_scene.jpg"
